w: During a question - answer session with Swamishri, a question was posed, "Say a sentence in English." Swamishri replied, "If I don't know then how can I say it? It is good that you have all come (into Satsang). We all have to offer love to God. What is an ant (a soul) before God? Still, Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj loves us. Therefore we should also have love for them." Then Swamishri addressing all the kishores spoke in english, "I love you all." And the conference hall thundered with the unanimous sound of clapping.

In the concluding session of the Kishore Shibir, Swamishri logically explained the importance of spirituality: "Today, kishores ask why in all things. Why mandir? Why puja? But do you ever ask, Why eat? Because you know that if you don't eat you'll die. Do you ever ask, Why school? Why hospital? If you are ill or have a disease then you have to be admitted there. Likewise, coming to the mandir, reading our scriptures and listening to discourses from sadhus cures the mind of its inner diseases. Even here we have operations on removing base instincts (swabhavas). So you shoud go to the mandir, do puja daily, apply tilak - chandlo and never feel why in these things ..."

Kirtan Bhakti Din On this auspicious day of Dev Shayani Ekadashi, the onset of Chaturmas, sadhus sang many kirtans, keeping the assembly engrossed in God for over two hours at the Bob Carr Center for Performing Arts. The Attorney General of the State of Florida, Hon. Charlie Crist, was present and felicitated Pramukh Swami Maharaj.

In his blessings, Swamishri explained, “With this human birth, we must attain the bliss and abode of God and liberate our souls. This can be done by taking refuge in God, developing faith in God, and abiding by His wishes.”

pr.t: Spiritual Knowledge is Panaced of All ills
w: Monzor Hurani, a renowned engineer and architect, was impressed by his visit to the Houston Mandir and the darshan of Swamishri. On meeting Swamishri he described his emotional pain on losing his mother and brothers. He asked why God did it. Swamishri replied, “God desires to do good of all. Because of man’s base nature, ego, he experiences pain and disease. The misery and pain come and go, but one has to understand that whatever God does is only for the good of all. Some die in wars and other situations. One who is born will die. How the person will die is unknown, but it is guaranteed. And because of our love it is natural to feel mournful and heavy-hearted, however, through our good deeds God is pleased and we feel peace in our hearts. Death is the order of this world. So many have died. Genetic science is good for it will increase one’s longevity, resolve diseases and allow one to live happily but death will definitely come. So to overcome this pain one needs spiritual knowledge. Further, the more good and charitable acts one does the more inner peace one gets.” Mr Monzur Hunani was satisfied with Swamishri’s guidance and blessings.

A spiritually-inclined Bengali youth, Subrato, came to seek Swamishri’s blessings. He asked, “Is it possible to realize God in this birth?” Swamishri replied, “Why not! Come to the mandir regularly, take the refuge of God and spiritually associate with sadhus. You will realize God.” Swamishri outlined in brief the spiritual sadhana to realize God.

L. D. Mittal, owner of Sonalika Tractors, came for the darshan of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. He is the ambassador here of the country of Macedonia, and has recently also launched a vehicle called 'Rhino' on the market. He said to Swamishri, "We have learned a great deal from you. I want your blessings that I go up (from this world) peacefully."
He expressed his faith and goodwill. Swamishri gave him blessings.

Giving words of advice to a spiritual seeker, Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "We have to make satsang grow. We have to bring the devotees into harmony with one another. If there is no harmony among us, there will be none among them. We should behave in such a way that the devotees too see virtue. Shriji Maharaj has said, 'Whoever lives in satsang as the servant of servants, I will consider his devotion good and delight in his colour...' We are not to do anything for the sake of position. We are to act according to the commands. Brahmanand Swami built the Vartal mandir and was then removed from there, but he did not feel anything in his mind. We have to become simple like that. If we walk according to the wishes of the Satpurush and the guru, they will be pleased. Everyone should sit together and eat together. Everyone is good. So do not speak negatively about one another. Do not think, 'Only we understand and others do not understand.' Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj worked only by tolerating others. In the same way, we want to make satsang grow, not shrink. Even if things do not go as you wish, stay happy."
He said, "Please be pleased with me."
Swamishri said, "I am pleased. Live in unity, get along together and work."

If we act according to the wishes of the Satpurush and the guru, they are pleased. Everyone should sit together and eat together. Everyone is good. So do not talk about your dislike of one another. Do not think, 'Only we understand and others do not.' Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj did the work only by putting up with others. In the same way, we want to make the satsang grow, not shrink. Even if things do not happen as we wish, remain happy."
He said, "Please remain pleased."
Swamishri said, "We are pleased. Live and work together in unity and harmony."

Today, during the walk, a reading from Yogi Vani took place: "Even if it does not fit one's intellect, if one accepts it at once, then the understanding of faultlessness becomes firm and the great sadhu is pleased."
Mahant Swami Maharaj said, "In spirituality, the intellect is nothing. The use of the intellect is to recognise the great sadhu. Not after recognising him."

Then, making a fine point, he said, "Even if it does not fit the intellect, one accepts it; it is not that one does not accept it, but one accepts it with doubt. 'At once' means accepting immediately, without doubt."

ds.t: Not for any amount of dollars
w: Today, after Mahant Swami Maharaj's meal was over, Sergeant Joe Bussey, head of the team serving on security, came to meet Swamishri. He has come to feel great attachment and devotion towards Swamishri. After the seva here began, a company asked him to come and work for them, where he would get 100$ an hour. It was a 12 day contract, but he said no. So the other company asked, "Then tell us how much you want." He said, "As long as Mahant Swami Maharaj is here, I will not go, however many dollars anyone gives."
Such attraction in just nine days! And that too in a completely new foreign officer!!
Swamishri blessed him and fulfilled him.
